input: Map out a 10-day road trip itinerary

gold.taskTitle: Map Out a 10-Day Road Trip Itinerary
gold.taskDescription: Plan a detailed 10-day road trip itinerary tailored to the user's destination, travel style, and preferences.

questions.title: Where does the road trip start and end?
questions.description: Identify the departure city or location and whether the trip is a loop back to the start or a one-way route.

questions.title: Which country, region, or destination are you targeting?
questions.description: Determine the general geographic area or specific route corridor the user wants to travel through.

questions.title: How many people are traveling on this trip?
questions.description: Understand the group size and composition, such as solo, couple, family with kids, or a group of friends.

questions.title: What is your total budget for the entire trip?
questions.description: Clarify the overall spending limit to shape accommodation, dining, and activity recommendations appropriately.

questions.title: What type of activities do you most want to include?
questions.description: Find out whether the user prefers nature and hiking, cultural landmarks, food and nightlife, adventure sports, or a mix.

questions.title: What are your accommodation preferences for each night?
questions.description: Determine whether the user wants hotels, motels, Airbnbs, camping, or a combination throughout the trip.

questions.title: Are there any fixed dates or time-sensitive constraints?
questions.description: Identify whether the trip has a set start date, specific events to attend, or seasonal considerations that affect planning.
